title: Working Station Four Screen Multifunctional Type C HUB Adapter
body_html:
Product information:

Material: Aluminium alloy
Color: Dark grey
Weight: 400g
Extension interface:
4K HDMI*2, 4K DP*2, USB3.0*3, USB3.0 Type-C Data*2, SD/TF*1, RJ45*1, Audio(3.5mm audio)*1, Type-C to Host*1, Type-C PD*1, DC(power supply)*1
PD input: 100W
DC input: 12V/3A
HDMI: Supports 4K@60Hz HD display
DisplayPort: Supports 4K@60Hz HD display
USB3.0: 5Gbps transmission rate, support for 5V/1.5A charging
USB3.0 Type-C Data: Supports reading from Type-C flash disk (Type-C audio output not supported)
SD/TF: Maximum 2T data reading is supported (simultaneous reading not supported, card inserted first is preferentially read)
RJ45: Gigabit network speed, wired network connection
Audio(3.5mm audio): Supports input and output
Type-C to Host: Connect to a computer for information transfer
Type-C PD: Support 100W charge fast
DC(power supply): 36W power socket (CN+EU+US)
